name: How much does a curbless shower conversion typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a curbless shower conversion typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a curbless shower conversion depends on structural framing requirements, waterproofing systems, and material selections. Modifying floor joists, installing recessed shower pans, coordinating licensed trade work for drain relocation, and custom tile installation require more labor than replacing a standard curbed pan. Choosing premium materials like natural marble, specialty mosaic floor tile, or custom frameless glass will increase your budget. Structural surprises found after demolishing old showers, such as rotted subfloors or venting issues, can also affect total costs. You receive a detailed breakdown of finish carpentry, waterproofing, and tile labor before work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on framing modifications, plumbing relocation, and tile choices, typically requiring more labor than standard curbed shower installations.
